title: Home title carries the search words and every breadcrumb trail starts at Home (SCAN-1026)
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-22. The home title fallback still read the tagline although the 2026-10-19 owner ruling (SCAN-1017) says the title tag carries the search words; it now reads FREQUENCY_PAGE_SEO.home.title, and the Open Graph block gains type website. An operator-edited title at /pages/home still wins. breadcrumbSchema prepends Home when the caller passes only the current page, so the markup matches the visible trail.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=fs.readFileSync('app/page.tsx','utf8');const j=fs.readFileSync('lib/jsonld.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(!p.includes('FREQUENCY_PAGE_SEO.home.title'))bad.push('home title fallback is not the ruled title');if(!/type: 'website'/.test(p))bad.push('home has no og:type');if(!/name: 'Home', path: '\\/'/.test(j))bad.push('breadcrumbs do not start at Home');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-1026: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the home title falls back to the tagline, og:type disappears, or breadcrumb markup stops starting at Home.
